// Vendored snapshot. Do not edit — re-export instead.

{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.62

|serverExec= server

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|gr2= Multiplayer

|descr= MP server only: Adds player score.
{{{!}} class="wikitable align-center"
! Kill Type
{{!}} infantry	{{!}}{{!}} soft	{{!}}{{!}} armor	{{!}}{{!}} air	{{!}}{{!}} killed
{{!}}-
! Score Points
{{!}} 1		{{!}}{{!}} 2	{{!}}{{!}} 3		{{!}}{{!}} 5	{{!}}{{!}} -1
{{!}}}

|s1= unit [[addPlayerScores]] values

|p1= unit: [[Object]]
|p2= values: [[Array]] with [killsInfantry, killsSoft, killsArmor, killsAir, score]
* killsInfantry: [[Number]] - number of infantry units killed
* killsSoft: [[Number]] - number of soft vehicles killed
* killsArmor: [[Number]] - number of armored vehicles killed
* killsAir: [[Number]] - number of air vehicles killed
* score: [[Number]] - total score

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>player addPlayerScores [0, 1, 0, 0, 1];</sqf>

|seealso= [[addScore]] [[addScoreSide]] [[getPlayerScores]] [[score]] [[scoreSide]]
}}

{{Note
|user= Beno 83au
|timestamp= 20170502014800
|text= As this command will add the given number to a player's score, a little bit of thought needs to be given to friendly-fire if it is for something like a deathmatch or a FFA, due to friendly-fire incurring negative points.
So to counter this just add 2 points every time a player kills a unit from the same side:
<sqf>player addPlayerScores [2, 0, 0, 0, 0];</sqf>
The 2 points will add 1 point to counter the negative friendly-fire point and 1 point to add correctly to the score.
}}
